name: Red Security Keycard
description: A red keycard that grants access to the laboratory

interactions.examine: A red keycard with warning symbols and the words 'RESEARCH DIVISION - EXPECT EXPLOSIONS.' Professor Scrubsworth probably left this lying around somewhere. The back has a handwritten note: 'If found, please return. Or keep it, I have seventeen more.'
interactions.take: You take the red keycard. It feels slightly warm, as if it's been near too many experiments. Probably fine.
